title: Two-node VRRP VM test: promote, demote, fault, single-active units
description: Extend the multi-node VM harness (router-osv) with a two-router VRRP scenario and a WAN simulator: election, VIP move, delayed fail-back (preemptDelay), FAULT on LAN loss, reboot of the MASTER, singleActiveUnits start/stop, zoneReplication.ha promote/demote, and exclusive WAN ownership. Source: discussion 21 Q2/Q4. Acceptance: nix flake check runs it; it fails if both nodes hold the WAN or a zone as Primary.
close_reason: Merged in #158 (vm-router-ha-pair: crash, FAULT on LAN loss, reboot, preemptDelay, single-active units, exclusive ownership sampling) and #159 (vm-router-technitium-zone-ha: zone ownership follows VRRP, exactly one Primary; found and fixed the NOTIFY refusal, the boot-order race and the short API wait).

title: Commit-confirm style auto-rollback and config diff for router changes
description: VyOS commit-confirm reverts a change that is not confirmed in time; nixos-rebuild has no equivalent, so a bad network change can lock out a remote operator. Provide a confirm-or-revert apply (e.g. switch, then revert to the previous generation unless confirmed within N seconds) plus a preview of the effective change (closure diff and rendered nftables/keepalived/Kea/networkd diff). Acceptance: a VM test applies a configuration that breaks management access, does not confirm, and the router returns to the previous generation within the timeout; a confirmed apply stays. Source: discussion 22 (5/5).
close_reason: Shipped in #164 (router-apply switch/confirm/diff with auto-revert; vm-router-apply)

title: router-ha: expose Keepalived GARP refresh options
description: Use Keepalived's built-in gratuitous ARP/NA (vrrp_garp_master_delay, vrrp_garp_master_repeat, garp_master_refresh) instead of arping/ndisc6 scripts proposed by the ecosystem plan. Measure convergence on Proxmox and the physical switch before tuning. Source: discussion 21 Q3.
close_reason: Merged in #154: services.router-ha.garp.* rendered per instance, keepalived config-test. Convergence measurement waits for the nch-sny.36 rehearsal.

comments.author: deepwatrcreatur
comments.text: PR #154 exposes the options. Convergence measurement needs a live pair; do it during the nch-sny.36 rehearsal before tuning.

title: router-ipsec: route-based IPsec with strongSwan swanctl and XFRM
description: Adopt-modified (4/5 prefer XFRM over VTI). Use the nixpkgs strongswan-swanctl module, XFRM interfaces (networkd Kind=xfrm, if_id), credentials from files, IKE/ESP allowed only on the WAN for configured peers, tunnel interfaces placed in an explicit router-zones zone, optional BGP over the tunnel through router-bgp. Document that SAs re-establish after VRRP failover and check flowtable interaction. Acceptance: VM test against a strongSwan peer: SA established, ping through the XFRM interface, BGP Established over it, no cleartext fallback. Source: discussion 22.
close_reason: Shipped in #170 (router-ipsec XFRM + swanctl, router-bgp policy fix; VM-tested)

title: router-ha: typed single-active ownership; decide keaSync
description: The keaSync option (modules/router-ha.nix:196, opens port 8000) contradicts the documented single-active DHCP model. Decide: retire keaSync or make Kea HA real and tested. Model per-service VRRP ownership (Kea, DDNS, UPnP, RA, Technitium zones) as typed options in the zoneReplication.ha pattern rather than a static nodeMode. Source: discussion 21 Q3/Q4. Acceptance: one documented DHCP HA model; ownership assertions; VM test coverage via the two-node test.
close_reason: Merged in #156: Kea HA made real (vm-router-kea-ha: sync, ~13 s takeover, fail-back resync), HA port scoped to the peer, keaSync retired, ownership assertion for singleActiveUnits. Typed ownership for DDNS/UPnP/RA split to a new bead.

comments.author: deepwatrcreatur
comments.text: Kea HA made real and tested: branch feat/kea-ha-vm-test adds vm-router-kea-ha (load-balancing sync, failover to partner-down ~55-60 s, fail-back resync ~20 s, no duplicate leases), scopes HA port 8000 to the peer via router-firewall, retires router-ha.keaSync (warns, no longer opens 8000 on every interface), and fails eval if kea-dhcp4-server is in singleActiveUnits with Kea HA on.

title: router-ha: WAN promotion without restarting systemd-networkd
description: notify_master (modules/router-ha.nix:80) restarts systemd-networkd, bouncing LAN and management at the moment of failover. Replace with per-link control: the WAN .network uses ActivationPolicy=manual (always-down conflicts with networkctl reconfigure) and promotion runs networkctl up/reconfigure on the WAN only; demotion networkctl down. Verify DHCPv4 and DHCPv6-PD re-acquire on the pinned systemd. Source: discussion 21 Q3 (5/5). Acceptance: two-node VM test shows no carrier/address change on LAN or management during promotion and demotion; docs updated.
close_reason: Merged in #155: WAN promotion via networkctl up/reconfigure only, ActivationPolicy=manual on the detected WAN network, vm-router-ha-wan-failover (~4 s planned failover, LAN/mgmt untouched). Follow-ups: router-afb (WAN health in VRRP priority), DUIDType=link-layer for a stable delegated prefix.

comments.author: deepwatrcreatur
comments.text: PR #155 (VM test vm-router-ha-wan-failover). PD prefix may change on failover because the DUID differs per node; consider DUIDType=link-layer with the cloned MAC as a follow-up.

title: router-ha: keep the delegated IPv6 prefix across failover
description: Each node has its own DHCPv6 DUID, so an ISP that binds the delegated prefix to the DUID hands the new master a different prefix and LAN clients renumber. Derive a shared DUID (e.g. DUIDType=link-layer from the cloned MAC, or a configured DUIDRawData) for the HA WAN. Acceptance: in vm-router-ha-wan-failover, with the simulated ISP binding PD to the client DUID, the same /56 is delegated to both nodes across failover and fail-back. Source: discussion 22 (5/5).
close_reason: Shipped in #162 (wan.sharedDhcpIdentity: shared DUID-LL/IAID; vm-router-ha-wan-failover)

title: 98 Subnet Overlap, MTU & Topology Invariant Assertions
description: Implement pure Nix evaluation-time assertions in modules/lib/ip.nix and modules/router-networking.nix detecting overlapping prefixes, out-of-bounds DHCP pools, and MTU violations.
close_reason: Implemented pure Nix IP CIDR library, subnet overlap assertions, DHCP pool containment, VLAN MTU invariant, and VRRP VIP separation

title: router-ha: lower VRRP priority when the master's WAN fails
description: A failed networkctl reconfigure (or a dead upstream) leaves keepalived MASTER without a working WAN; nothing demotes it. Add a keepalived track_script/track_interface option (e.g. DHCP lease present + upstream ping) that lowers priority so the peer takes over. Raised by CodeAnt on PR #155 (modules/router-ha.nix:84). Needs a VM test: ISP stops answering on the master's WAN, peer takes over.
close_reason: Shipped in #161 (wan.healthCheck: FAULT yield + priority pin; vm-router-ha-wan-health), headroom fix #174

comments.author: deepwatrcreatur
comments.text: Discussion 22 (VyOS plan review): top priority, 5/5 voices. Acceptance: in the two-router VM test, the master's upstream stops answering while carrier stays up; the master's priority drops and the VIP and WAN move to the peer within 5 s, LAN clients keep internet access, and recovery respects preemptDelay. Also decide whether the LAN and WAN instances need a vrrp_sync_group. nixpkgs keepalived is built without --enable-bfd, so track_bfd is not available without an override; use a track_script.

title: router-ha: typed single-active ownership for DDNS, UPnP and RA
description: Split from router-4dk. Model per-service VRRP ownership (kea-dhcp-ddns, UPnP, router advertisements) as typed options in the zoneReplication.ha pattern instead of raw singleActiveUnits, with assertions and coverage in the two-node VM test. Kea DHCPv4 itself is now covered by router-kea.dhcp4.ha (#156).
close_reason: Shipped in #166 (router-ha ownership for RA, DDNS, UPnP and Kea D2; VM-tested)

title: routerctl: ha, leases, dns and routes subcommands
description: Absorbs the VyOS plan's 'router-cli' (rejected as a duplicate). Extend pkgs/router-diag routerctl with ha (/run/router-ha/role, keepalived and Kea HA state), leases (Kea /run/kea/dhcp4.sock, DHCPv4 only), dns (Technitium zone types and sync state via the API, checking .status), routes (kernel FIB plus vtysh JSON), with stable --json and explicit unavailable states and no secret output. Acceptance: the JSON shape of each subcommand is asserted inside an existing two-router VM test, including a disabled/unavailable service. Source: discussion 22 (5/5).
close_reason: Shipped in #163 (routerctl ha/leases/dns/routes with --json; asserted in vm-router-kea-ha and vm-router-technitium-zone-ha)

title: router-ha: VRRP auth secret as a file, no default password
description: vrrpPassword defaults to nix-router-ha and is rendered into keepalived.conf in the Nix store (modules/router-ha.nix:144-147, 274-279). Add vrrpPasswordFile (credential, rendered at runtime), deprecate the inline option with a warning, drop the default. Note VRRP PASS auth is weak by design; document that the LAN must be trusted. Source: discussion 21 Q4 (Claude). Acceptance: no secret in the store; eval check; migration note.
close_reason: Merged in #153: vrrpPasswordFile via systemd credential, no store copy, keepalived config-tested.

title: 95 Hardware Optimization Safety Matrix & LRO Removal
description: Purge hazardous lro on from modules/router-optimizations.nix, enforce safe GRO forwarding defaults, and implement driver-aware hardware offload capability negotiation and runtime status tracking in /run/router/nic-offload-status.json.
close_reason: Purged hazardous lro on, enforced safe GRO, implemented driver-aware capability negotiation and /run/router/nic-offload-status.json tracker

title: router-ospf and router-bfd: deferred until a peer and convergence goal exist
description: Discussion 22: OSPF is a thin layer over services.frr but neither goal needs it yet; BFD only once a routing peer or a measured convergence target exists. nixpkgs keepalived lacks --enable-bfd, so VRRP+BFD needs a package override. When picked up: FRR peer VMs for OSPF adjacency and route withdrawal; BFD detect time is multiplier x interval (300 ms x 3 = ~900 ms). EVPN/VXLAN rejected for scope; NetFlow/IPFIX deferred to router-observability.

title: router-multicast: igmpproxy for IPTV, after HA hardening
description: Adopt-modified (5/5). igmpproxy as the default (proxy semantics for IPTV), smcroute only for static cross-VLAN routes. Upstream is a configurable interface (often an ISP IPTV VLAN), never assumed to be the WAN. nftables: IGMP on the upstream, forward 224.0.0.0/4 only to listed downstreams; handle rp_filter. No ISP-specific promises in docs; document IGMPv3/SSM limits and quickleave effects. Both daemons lack NixOS modules. Acceptance: VM test with an upstream source and querier, a downstream receiver joins and receives, stops after leave, and another VLAN never receives. Source: discussion 22.
close_reason: Shipped in #169 (router-multicast igmpproxy; VM-tested)

title: 96 Multi-Node NixOS VM Test Harness
description: Implement multi-node QEMU virtual integration tests in tests/vm/ validating DHCP, NAT, DNS, and zone drop policies across virtual nodes.
close_reason: Implemented multi-node QEMU VM test harness with wanSimulator, router, client, and iotNode verifying DHCP, NAT, DNS, zone isolation, and routerctl diagnostics

title: router-kea: dhcp4.ha hot-standby mode
description: Why: router-kea.dhcp4.ha hard-codes mode = load-balancing. ISC prefers hot-standby, and it fits a preferred node plus a spare (docs/router-ha-prior-art.md, adopted item 1). Add dhcp4.ha.mode (enum load-balancing|hot-standby, default load-balancing for compatibility); in hot-standby the primary role is 'primary' and the other 'standby'. Acceptance: option + docs (router-kea / pair guide / prior-art status), eval check of the rendered Kea HA config for both modes, and a VM test in which the standby serves a client only after the primary stops.
close_reason: dhcp4.ha.mode hot-standby, merged in #185

title: router-ha: deliver notify transitions in order (notify_fifo)
description: Why: keepalived starts one notify script per transition without waiting for the previous one; MASTER quickly followed by FAULT can run networkctl down before networkctl up and leave the WAN up on a FAULT node (docs/router-ha-prior-art.md, adopted item 2; NethSecurity serialises its hooks). Use keepalived notify_fifo with a single reader that applies master/backup/fault/stop in order. Acceptance: VM test that forces back-to-back transitions and asserts the final WAN, role file and single-active units match the final state; docs updated.
close_reason: keepalived notify FIFO with ordered reader, reload recovery; merged in #186

title: Correct and label the ecosystem plan and FreeBSD comparison
description: Discussion 21 found: ignores #144-#150, VIP shown live, X520 incident omitted; conntrackd -C (should be -c); RFC 9686 misattributed (IPv6-Only Preferred is RFC 8925); CARP 'identical' to VRRP (analogous; VRRPv3 is RFC 9568); '100% bit-identical'; unsourced performance numbers; overstated session-loss claims; OPNsense rollback outdated. Add a header 'research input; unverified where marked', fix the errors, and fold accepted items into the discussion 20 roadmap rather than a parallel plan. Acceptance: both docs corrected and linked from discussion 21.
close_reason: Revision 2 (2026-11-19) of ECOSYSTEM-RESEARCH-AND-IMPROVEMENT-PLAN.md adds an authoritative §0 (state, priorities, verdicts, corrections) and inline [rev 2] fixes; FREEBSD-OPNSENSE-COMPARISON.md corrected and dated. PR #151.

title: 99 Systemd Slice Isolation & Framework Rebranding
description: Introduce systemd resource slices with memory/CPU boundaries, rebrand framework identity away from RouterOS-like, and publish docs/COMPATIBILITY.md.
close_reason: Defined router systemd resource slices, rebranded framework to topology-driven architecture, and published COMPATIBILITY.md

title: Make the existing examples, tests and tags visible (releases, changelog, README quickstart)
description: Discussion 23 (docs/discussions/23-clan-inventory-integration.md): the adoption gap is visibility and trust, not content. Examples (router-single-basic.nix, router-ha-pair-example.nix) and 30+ VM/eval checks exist, tags go to v0.10.0, but there are no GitHub Releases, no top-level changelog, no topics, and the README does not lead with a quickstart. Do: GitHub Releases from existing tags with notes; CHANGELOG.md; a short stability policy for option names; README opening with the typed-topology differentiator and a quickstart that links the examples and names the VM tests covering them; CI badge; repo topics (nixos, router, vrrp, kea, nftables, flake). Then a NixOS Discourse post (operator decides when). Acceptance: release page and changelog exist, README first screen has the quickstart.

title: router-dashboard: make gateway-health ping targets configurable
description: The dashboard's gateway-health panel (modules/router-dashboard/api/server.py, handle_gateway_health) pings the default gateway plus hardcoded 1.1.1.1 (Cloudflare) and 8.8.8.8 (Google). Every other external target in the flake is an option (router-mwan.trackIp, router-dns-service fallbackNameservers, router-ha wan.healthCheck.targets), and consumers cannot change these without patching Python. Add services.router-dashboard.gatewayHealth.targets (list of { name; host; }, default today's two, gateway always included) passed to the API through its config, document it, and add an eval check that the rendered config carries the targets. Raised by the operator on 2026-11-22.

title: 97 routerctl CLI Diagnostics & Static Firewall Explainer
description: Refactor pkgs/router-diag into modular routerctl CLI with JSON output and static policy explainability via /etc/router/policy-manifest.json.
close_reason: Refactored router-diag into routerctl with subcommands, --json support, /etc/router/policy-manifest.json, and firewall explain

title: router-ha: option to keep the WAN DHCP lease on demotion (no release)
description: Why: some ISPs hold a released address for a cooldown; with a cloned MAC and shared identity the new master can renew the same lease (docs/router-ha-prior-art.md, adopted item 3). Add services.router-ha.wan.sendRelease (nullOr bool, default null = networkd default) mapped to SendRelease= in the WAN network's DHCPv4 and DHCPv6 config. Acceptance: eval check; VM test that the ISP sees no RELEASE on demotion when false and the peer gets the same lease; docs.
close_reason: Measured: demotion's networkctl down sends no DHCP RELEASE, so no option was needed; pinned by vm-router-ha-wan-failover in #187

title: 91 Router HA Lab systemd-nspawn Phase-1 Harness
description: Add isolated HA development harness using systemd-nspawn/NixOS containers under lab/.

title: Investigate DHCPv6 and prefix delegation serving for downstream networks
description: The flake has no DHCPv6 server module (Kea is DHCPv4 only here). First document what networkd already provides (RA, DHCPv6 server, sub-prefix delegation from the ISP PD), then decide whether a module is needed. Keep this separate from preserving the ISP prefix across failover. Acceptance: a written decision in docs with a VM check of whatever is adopted. Source: discussion 22.
close_reason: Shipped in #168 (docs/router-ipv6-downstream.md decision, ipv6SubnetId, managed-mode warning; VM-tested)

title: DHCP relay and option 82 via systemd-networkd
description: systemd-networkd [DHCPServer] supports RelayTarget=, RelayAgentCircuitId= and RelayAgentRemoteId= (verified in systemd 259), so a relay needs no new daemon. Add a typed option for relaying a routed interface to a central DHCP server with an explicit option-82 policy. Acceptance: VM test with client, relay router and a separate DHCP server VM; the client gets a lease through the relay and option 82 is present. Source: discussion 22 (5/5 adopt).
close_reason: Shipped in #167 (router-dhcp-relay with option 82; VM-tested)

description: After the discussion-22 work items land, update docs/VYOS-FEATURE-PARITY-PLAN.md (capability table, gap list, evidence levels) and the Comparative Feature Matrix in docs/ECOSYSTEM-RESEARCH-AND-IMPROVEMENT-PLAN.md (HA row is outdated: VRRP now has VM-tested WAN failover, Kea HA, zone ownership, preemptDelay) to reflect what shipped, with links to the tests that prove each claim. Re-verify VyOS facts against current upstream docs at that time.
close_reason: Done in #176: VyOS page revision 3; ecosystem plan revision 3 (shipped table with test links, feature matrix, stale items marked)
